correctedFindings.resolution: All81 inventoried excluded rows are accounted for in their effective query families as screened raw discoveries or exact already-verified paper-to-primary-URL mappings. Zero inventoried secondary hosts remain in current excluded paper rows. Current mapped occurrences identify UFMF, EvoOcc, RoadOcc, GUIDE and DriveOSS with exact current reference title, canonical ID and primary URL; no new acceptance follows from secondary discovery.

validation.result: Only nine pending independentReview.status/reviewers/rounds errors for these three directions; no content or audit count/identity errors.
independentChecks: Every current screen record matches an exact original effective-query URL and title.
Every current secondary mapping matches an original discovery occurrence and an exact already-verified reference title, canonical ID and primary URL.
Every inventoried raw secondary URL is screened or mapped in its original effective query family.
Candidate family unions, sample IDs, ledger family membership, unique row counts and occurrence totals reconcile.
All153 reference records, non-audit content, source accepted counts, retained IDs, local-corpus audit and nested historicalRun snapshots remain unchanged.
Raw discovery counts remain radar152, dynamic125 and LiDAR110; candidate counts exclude scoped-out raw records.

approvalBoundary: PASS binds only the listed reviewSnapshotFingerprint values, excluding mutable independentReview metadata. This closes the bounded observed S5 defect; same-family provisional review and prior source-depth limits remain. No reproduction, deployment or notification certification.
